lines.say: The study police have made an arrest.
Suspect: the flashcard app. Face the camera.
Count one: four hundred cards. Never told you which were due.
Count two: you flipped it, saw the answer, and called that revision.
Count three: it has no idea when your exam is.
Sentence: life, in a folder you never open.
Offload knows your exam date, and plans your revision for you.
It tests you, and brings each card back before you forget it.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
